newsitem.title: EGYPT: Spain's King Juan Carlos off to Luxor in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Spain's King Juan Carlos off to Luxor in Egypt.

text.p: Spain's King Juan Carlos and Queen Sophia flew to Luxor in southern Egypt on Thursday to tour the city's pharaonic monuments, airport officials said.
The king arrived in Cairo on Monday on his first state visit to an Arab country since 1977.
He has since held talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak and addressed a business encouter aimed at encouraging economic cooperation between the two countries.
Luxor is home to some of Egypt's most famous pharaonic monuments and several well-preserved tombs belonging to the country's ancient rulers.
